mechanism: Rifampin induces CYP3A4 and other metabolic pathways, potentially increasing etanercept clearance and reducing TNF-α inhibitor efficacy; additionally, rifampin may impair immune responses needed for TNF-α inhibitor function.
action: Monitor clinical response to etanercept closely; consider etanercept dose adjustment or alternative tuberculosis therapy if efficacy appears compromised; ensure adequate tuberculosis control given the immunosuppressive effects of etanercept.
